title: Division Curriculum — the spine every course in a division shares (2026)
description: One 12-Saturday term for each of the four divisions, teaching what every course inside it has in common: deliberate practice and critique for the arts, audience and story for media, computational thinking and debugging for technology, and evidence and margin for business. lessons.title: Why you make things
lessons.summary: What creative work is for, and the difference between making and performing for an audience.
objectives: You will say who your work is for
You will describe one piece that moved you and why
You will name what you want to be good at
lessons.body:
## What to do

- Discuss: who is this for, and what should it do to them?
- Each person describes one piece of work that moved them
- Write what you want to be able to do by the end of the term

lessons.summary: Deliberate practice: short, specific, uncomfortable and repeated, rather than long and vague.
objectives: You will break a skill into one specific weakness
